Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir

Class InjectionVlpProvider

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.reservoir.InjectionVlpProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
VlpProvider
public final class InjectionVlpProvider extends Object implements VlpProvider
Lift performance of an injection well (water or gas) for VFPINJ tables: the bottom-hole pressure delivered at a surface injection rate and a given wellhead pressure.

The tubing survey is marched from the wellhead to the datum. Each sub-segment is flashed at its mean temperature and a predicted mean pressure, so density and viscosity follow the real fluid (a compressible gas or water with a salinity correction). Friction uses the Darcy-Weisbach equation with the Haaland friction factor and the hydrostatic term uses the true vertical depth difference. Positive depth is downward, so pressure gains hydrostatic head and loses Darcy-Weisbach friction along the injection direction. Acceleration is neglected. The temperature is interpolated linearly with true vertical depth between the wellhead and bottom-hole values.

The rate is the surface volume rate in Sm3/day of the injected phase, converted to mass with the density of the template fluid at 15 C and 1.01325 bara. Water ratios, gas ratios and lift quantity are ignored. The provider keeps one working fluid and is not thread safe.

This implementation is final so a subclass cannot expose a partially constructed provider through finalization after input validation or fluid initialization fails. Implement VlpProvider for a custom injection model.

  • Constructor Details

    • InjectionVlpProvider

      public InjectionVlpProvider(SystemInterface template, double[] md, double[] tvd, double[] innerDiameter)
      Creates an injection provider for a surveyed tubing string.
      Parameters:
      template - injected fluid, a fully specified system with a mixing rule (for example pure water with CPA); the system is cloned
      md - measured depth along the tubing from the wellhead, strictly increasing, starting at 0, in m
      tvd - true vertical depth from the wellhead in m, one value per measured depth
      innerDiameter - inner diameter in m for each interval between survey points (length md.length - 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the survey arrays are inconsistent

    • InjectionVlpProvider

      public InjectionVlpProvider(SystemInterface template, double tvd, double innerDiameter)
      Creates a vertical injection well.
      Parameters:
      template - injected fluid (see the survey constructor)
      tvd - true vertical depth in m
      innerDiameter - tubing inner diameter in m
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if depth or diameter is not positive

      public double bottomHolePressure(double rate, double outletPressure, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Calculates the flowing pressure at the table datum for one table coordinate.
      Specified by:
      bottomHolePressure in interface VlpProvider
      Parameters:
      rate - surface rate in Sm3/day of the table rate basis
      outletPressure - pressure at the outlet node (THP axis value) in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio in the unit of the selected water ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      gasRatio - gas ratio in the unit of the selected gas ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      alq - artificial lift quantity (gas lift rate in Sm3/day, 0 when not used)
      Returns:
      flowing pressure at datum in bara; NaN or an exception marks the point as infeasible
